edits.before: - Qiyana Audacity: matchup-defining — Her stick dash — once spent she cannot reach you; kite the cooldown. Count it out loud if you must. - Your spell shield (Iron Boundary) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
